versions.changelog:
- Initial release of coze-image skill for image generation via Coze AI platform.
- Supports text-to-image generation with automatic Base64 encoding for inline preview.
- Handles complete workflow: prompt submission, SSE response parsing, image download, and Base64 conversion.
- Flexible authentication using API token (inline or via environment variables).
- Features robust error handling and optional debug mode.
- Easy installation and setup through ClawHub.
